label.description: Short text beside the mark. Falls back to the URL's host when unset.

platform.description: Which platform's glyph to draw beside the label (matches the ids in socialLinks.ts: 'flickr', 'vsco', 'bluesky' and so on). A free-form string rather than a closed set, so the catalogue can gain a platform without making existing records invalid; a name the renderer has no mark for falls back to a globe. Absent means a plain website.

link.description: DEPRECATED. Was one entry in the back cover's link row, before the colophon dropped links. Retained so older records remain valid.

cover.description: The photo to show as this zeen's card in listings and as its og:image. Normally the front cover's photo, stored here so a listing needs neither to parse `pages` nor to lay anything out.

pages.description: The zeen in reading order, first page first. Stored as authored specs rather than computed geometry: the layout engine turns these into frames at read time, so pages stay editable and re-layout when the engine improves. Capped at 60 — well past the length anyone reads in one sitting, and it bounds the record size.

theme.description: Type and colour choices. Absent means the defaults (modern / neutral).

title.description: Display title. Also the front cover's title unless that page overrides it.

status.description: 'draft' = still being authored; visible only to its author, carries no engagement, and is never indexed. 'published' = readable by anyone, likeable and commentable. Absent means 'draft': a record that never said it was published should not be treated as public.

app.zeens.v.description: Zeens marker so the firehose and lua filters can identify our records.

description.description: Short summary for listings and share previews. Used as the meta description when the zeen is published.

publishedAt.description: When the zeen was first published. Set once and not updated by later edits, so a re-edited zeen keeps its place in reverse-chronological listings.

allowDownload.description: Whether readers other than the author may export this zeen as a PDF. Absent means false: an author who has not said otherwise has not agreed to hand out a file. The author can always export their own work, so this governs OTHER people only. It is a permission on the export endpoint, not a protection on the pages themselves, which are readable by anyone once the zeen is published.

sourceCollection.description: Optional provenance: the app.zeens.collection photos were seeded from. A zeen is a SNAPSHOT — later changes to that collection do not alter it.

main.description: A zeen: a sequence of 1:1.414 pages (ISO A-series proportion) mixing photographs and writing, published as a readable object. Pages may draw photos from a collection, from individual posts, or from the author's own uploads — a zeen is a standalone document, not a view of a collection. The AUTHORED PAGES are the artifact: layout is recomputed from them at read time, so a layout improvement reaches every existing zeen. Replaces an earlier record of this NSID that described a print-ready PDF; that shape is gone and its records are inert.

body.description: Running text for story and back-cover pages. Blank lines separate paragraphs. Plain text, not markdown: a zeen page is laid out to a fixed frame, and inline formatting would fight the measured geometry.

align.description: Horizontal alignment for this page's title and byline. Absent means left, which is what the Figma frames show. Chiefly for covers: a portrait photograph leaves the title floating against one edge, and centring settles it.

links.description: DEPRECATED and no longer written. The back cover was reduced to a photo, a name and a line about the author — a colophon is a signature, not a link tree. Kept in the lexicon so records written before that change stay valid; the renderer ignores it.

title.description: Heading, on the layouts that have one (covers and story pages).

byline.description: The line under a cover title. Usually the author's display name, but authored rather than derived so a zeen can credit differently.

layout.description: Which arrangement to lay out. Named for what the page IS rather than numbered, so a reader of the record can tell what a page looks like. An unknown value falls back to 'story', which renders whatever text the page carries and drops nothing silently — which is also what happens to the four square-page layouts this set replaced (photo-portrait, photo-pair, photo-wide-over-pair, photo-grid): pages using them keep their words, and their photos stay on the record.

photos.description: Photos in slot order. Longer than the layout's slot count is ignored; shorter leaves slots empty. maxLength here and on every array parallel to it (slotFraming, captions, showMeta, showLocation) is the largest slot count any layout draws. It was 4 while the six-square grid drew 6, which silently dropped that page's last two photographs on save, and left its last two slots unable to carry a caption or an EXIF switch.

scheme.description: This page's ground and ink, as a PAIR. 'light' is a light ground with dark text, 'dark' the reverse; 'default' (or absent) follows the zeen's theme. Set per page so a dark text page can sit next to a light photo page — which is the usual way a printed zeen paces itself. A pair rather than two fields because the halves are only ever meaningful together: a light ground with light text is not a design, it is an unreadable page.

captions.description: Caption per photo slot, parallel to `photos` and keyed by SLOT rather than by photo: swapping the photo in a slot keeps the writing, and one photo can carry different words on different pages. A non-empty caption IS the switch to show one — an empty box and a hidden box mean the same thing on a page.

showMeta.description: Per-slot switch for the CAMERA SETTINGS line, parallel to `photos`. Per photo rather than per page because on a multi-photo page one frame may be worth annotating and the others not. Absent or false prints nothing. Location is a separate switch (`showLocation`): the two are different disclosures, and an author who wants to name the place has not thereby agreed to publish the lens they used, or the reverse.

avatarUrl.description: The author's profile photo on the back cover, as an image-proxy path. A URL rather than a blob ref because an avatar lives on the profile record rather than being one of the author's posts: it has no post URI, no EXIF and no aspect ratio, so threading it through `photos` would mean inventing all three. Snapshotted with the rest of the colophon, so a zeen keeps the face its author had when they made it. Ignored on every other layout.

bodyScale.description: Size of this page's RUNNING TEXT — the story body, the photo captions, or the back cover's about text — as a PERCENTAGE of the layout's own size (50 to 200, where 100 is unchanged). One field for all three because a page only ever draws one of them, and an author sizing the caption under a photograph is making the same decision as one sizing a story paragraph. Absent means 100. Stored as an integer because ATProto rejects floats. See also `titleScale` and `bylineScale`. Deliberately does NOT cover the location and camera-settings lines: those are joined on from the photograph's own record rather than authored on the page, and are already the smallest type on the sheet.

titleScale.description: Size of this page's title, as a PERCENTAGE of the layout's own size (50 to 200, where 100 is unchanged). A percentage rather than an absolute size because type on a zeen page is measured as a fraction of the page width, so an absolute value would mean something different at every render size and break the one-page-one-coordinate-space rule the engine depends on. Absent means 100. Stored as an integer because ATProto rejects floats. See also `bylineScale`.

bylineScale.description: Size of this page's byline, as a PERCENTAGE of the layout's own size (50 to 200, where 100 is unchanged). A percentage rather than an absolute size because type on a zeen page is measured as a fraction of the page width, so an absolute value would mean something different at every render size and break the one-page-one-coordinate-space rule the engine depends on. Absent means 100. Stored as an integer because ATProto rejects floats. See also `titleScale`.

slotFraming.description: Per-slot presentation, in slot order. Parallel to `photos`: entry i describes how photo i sits in its slot. Absent, or an absent entry, means the layout's own defaults, so every zeen written before this field stays correct.

showLocation.description: Per-slot switch for the LOCATION line, parallel to `photos`. Separate from `showMeta` so the place and the camera settings can be shown independently. The value shown is the free-form location the author already published on the post, never anything extracted from the file's GPS. Absent or false prints nothing.

page.description: One authored page. `layout` names the arrangement; `photos` fills its slots in order and `text` fills its text roles. A layout that wants more photos than are supplied simply renders fewer — a missing blob must never break the page around it.

type.description: Type pairing. 'modern' (Inter throughout, F5.6 for metadata) is the only one implemented; it matches what collection captions already use, so a zeen page and a collection read as one system. 'editorial' (DM Serif Display + Cascadia Mono) and 'classic' (fully serif) are reserved and need font files in BOTH woff2 and TrueType before they can render. Unknown or absent = 'modern'.

color.description: Palette: page ground, primary ink, muted ink for metadata, and the photo placeholder fill. Only 'neutral' (white ground, near-black ink) is implemented. Unknown or absent = 'neutral'.

theme.description: Presentation, as two INDEPENDENT axes rather than bundled styles, so any palette is available with any voice and a new face does not multiply the list. Both resolve to concrete faces and colours at layout time, so re-theming is a one-field edit that never rewrites pages. These are the ZEEN's own colours and do not follow the reader's app theme — a zeen looks the same to everyone, the way a printed object does, which is also what keeps the screen and the PDF in agreement.

alt.description: Alt text, carried on the ref so the zeen stays accessible without re-fetching the source post.

cid.description: CID of the image blob itself, NOT of the post record.

did.description: DID of the photo's author, whose repo holds the blob.

uri.description: Optional AT-URI of the post this photo came from, kept as provenance and so a page can link back to it.

aspectRatio.description: Natural dimensions, so a page can reserve the right space before the blob loads and the layout engine can crop to fill a slot without measuring.

photoRef.description: A photograph, addressed so it resolves without the reader needing the post it came from. `did` is the photo's AUTHOR — which owns the blob — and is NOT necessarily the zeen's owner, because photos may be drawn from a collection holding other people's work. Readers must ignore a ref missing either `cid` or `did`.

fit.description: 'fill' crops the photo to cover the slot; 'contain' shows the whole photograph with space around it. Absent means the layout's own choice, which differs per layout (a framed cover contains, a full-bleed one fills).

ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the slot's box. The reshaped box always fits INSIDE the space the layout gave the slot and is centred in it, so a ratio can never push a photo over text or off the page. Absent means the layout's own box.

focalX.description: Horizontal focal point when `fit` is 'fill', as thousandths so the value stays an integer (ATProto rejects floats). 0 = left edge, 500 = centred, 1000 = right. Absent means 500. Ignored under 'contain', where nothing is cropped.

focalY.description: Vertical focal point when `fit` is 'fill'. 0 = top, 500 = centred, 1000 = bottom. Absent means 500.

slotFrame.description: How one photo sits in its slot. Every field is optional; an empty object means the layout's defaults.
